title: Generate agent (isolated)
source: Chat correction 2026-09-06 — generate agent alone; no Caesar crawl

meta.summaryLong: If the user said do the research, this agent is entered only after clarify: generate vs fetch. Coding is a third wall and is not chosen by that phrase. This board is generate alone.

Serendipity-by-Design / combinatorial creativity: inject a remote paperId that is already in this paper DB. Do not ask the model to be analogical. If the id is not in DB, that is inventing a technique — refuse.

Structured recombination from the forced in-DB id plus the current page. Please-be-novel prompting is out. Caesar Phase-1 open-web crawl is refused (SSRF + cite-or-fetch). No cite invention — drafts may mark claims as ungrounded.
Write the ideation draft into Living Papers MD. Do not mint citation ids. If the draft later needs grounding, that is a later-turn fetch after clarify — not this agent becoming fetch.

Generate ≠ judge. Steal the role split (CycleResearcher / CycleReviewer moral), not Review-5k training. Same-model self-review is rejected on this fork. Creation-phase split is in DB as novelty vs corpus-grounded refinement.
